label: Run monitor
info: Read-only status and monthly run-log history for the report flows. Generate the access key on the HTTP In node after import.

name: [1] HTTP MONITOR
info: STAGE 1 - One access-key-protected route serves the page at /reports-monitor, status JSON at /reports-monitor/status, and one-month log history at /reports-monitor/history. Generate its access key in the VFC after import. The page reuses the key for its two read requests.

name: 1.1 Route monitor request
[2] PAGE
info: STAGE 2 - Returns the self-contained page. It polls status every 10 seconds and loads one month of CSV history only when requested.

name: 2.1 Build monitor page
func:

name: [3] STATUS
info: STAGE 3 - Returns compact snapshots only: report-day checkpoints, PBI build and listener state, Config state, plus a derived STUCK state after 30 minutes without a checkpoint.

name: 3.1 Build status JSON
[4] HISTORY REQUEST
info: STAGE 4 - Validates the flow and month, lists one log folder, and reads the requested monthly CSV only when it exists.

name: 4.1 Check history request
4.2 Find history file
4.3 Build history JSON
[5] ERROR RESPONSE
info: STAGE 5 - Invalid requests keep their explicit 400, 404 or 503 status and JSON error. A list-object response that is not a list returns 502.

name: [6] HISTORY NOT FOUND
info: STAGE 6 - A month with no CSV log returns 404 without starting a read-object request that could otherwise wait indefinitely.

name: [7] NODE ERROR
info: STAGE 7 - A data-lake node error returns a generic 502. Credentials and request keys are never copied into the response.

name: 7.1 Build error response
